title.narrative: INTERPEACE PROGRAM FOR THE ADVANCEMENT OF THE YOUTH PEACE AND SECURITY AGENDA

description.narrative: The From Policy to Delivery (Phase ll) project is Interpeace’s program to cultivate and support youth leadership in the implementation and advancement of the Youth, Peace & Security (YPS) Agenda. This programme aims to deepen Interpeace’s contribution to the implementation of the YPS agenda including in its field-based programs in three key areas through: Supporting youth (particularly young women), building meaningful inclusion, agency and leadership in the implementation and assessment of YPS at the country-level. It will amplify the voices of young women and men with national and multi-lateral policymakers; Engaging Interpeace’s field-based programmes to seed new forms of youth-led peacebuilding; and Working with various UN entities; convening civil society networks on YPS, engaging member states’ Missions to the UN – particularly Ireland – to advance the YPS Agenda.
